management_statements.value: CEO Eric Lefkofsky said Q2 was another exceptional quarter and that investments in AI were driving some of the strongest growth rates seen in Oncology Diagnostics and Data Licensing.

Regarding Personalis, management stated that the existing collaboration had demonstrated the combination of highly sensitive MRD technology with Tempus' commercial infrastructure and cited clinical adoption and reimbursement momentum.

Management stated current cash, marketable equity securities and anticipated operating cash flows are expected to satisfy anticipated cash requirements for more than twelve months from the Q2 2026 10-Q date.

risk_new_disclosures.value: New risk section for the proposed Personalis acquisition: closing is subject to Personalis shareholder approval, regulatory approvals and Nasdaq listing approval; the transaction may be delayed or not completed.

risk_new_disclosures.value: The Personalis merger agreement includes outside-date termination provisions, a Personalis termination right tied to a finally determined Tempus 15-trading-day VWAP below $46.00 immediately before closing, and approximately $76.8 million termination fees in specified circumstances.

risk_new_disclosures.value: Additional Personalis risks disclosed include loss of key personnel, significant transaction/integration costs, litigation risk, failure to integrate operations or realize anticipated benefits, increased operational complexity and ownership dilution.
